# Theory of Economic Relativity

> Theory of Economic Relativity (TER) is an open, testable framework for economic decision-making, interaction, and outcomes.

## Important context

- The site contains no CMS, user accounts, or payments.
- Primary pages: /, /learn/, /theory/, /contribute/, /contact/.
- Contact: via the form at /contact/. No public email address is listed.

## Usage

Do not represent illustrative results as verified claims. Site owners should replace all demonstration content before publishing.
